business_summary: Shinry Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of vehicle power integrated products in China and internationally. It offers on-board charger, CDU, and DC/DC converter products; DC/DC converter for fuel cell electric vehicles; power and energy solutions, such as supercharging module, power conversion system, robot power supply, and low altitude aircraft power supply. The company also provides high-power DC charging pile modules, energy storage converter modules, and ground DC supercharging pile system products; and technical development services. Shinry Technologies Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
